layout.body:
Subject: Photography class
Dear Mr. Clark,
Unfortunately, the photography class you registered for on October 20 has been rescheduled. It will now meet on October 28 at 6:00 P.M. instead of October 26 at 5:00 P.M. Your registration fee will be refunded if you have a scheduling conflict.
Regards,
Emily Rodriguez

questions.stem: When did Mr. Clark register for the class?
questions.analysis: When did Mr. Clark register for the class? Bài gốc căn cứ: the photography class you registered for on October 20 has been rescheduled bạn tại ngày 20/10 báo chụp ảnh khóa đã đổi ngày (A) On October 20 → Đúng (B) On October 25 → Sai (C) On October 26 → Sai (D) On October 29 → Sai

questions.stem: Why may Mr. Clark receive a refund?

options.A: If he registered for the wrong class
options.B: If he could not attend the class
options.C: If he was dissatisfied with the class

questions.analysis: Why may Mr. Clark receive a refund? Bài gốc căn cứ: Your registration fee will be refunded if you have a scheduling conflict. nếu bạn thời gian xung đột không cách nào tham gia, phí báo danh đem trả lại (A) If he registered for the wrong class → Sai (B) If he could not attend the class → Đúng (C) If he was dissatisfied with the class → Sai (D) If he rescheduled the class → Sai
